phrase: Two original songs for Singing Academy; broad deep-house and Eurodance directions, newly authored lyrics, no reference audio or hit-song adaptation.

cases.title: Long Way Home
cases.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Last train rolls beneath our feet
Your blue jacket brushes me
Rain runs silver down the glass
For once I let the moment last
Every street becomes a river
Every window holds a spark
You draw circles on the ticket
I forget to watch the dark
[Pre-Chorus]
Leave the hurry at the door
I can hear you through it all
[Chorus]
Take the long way home with me
Past the places we were meant to be
Let the morning wait outside
There is nothing left to hide
[Verse 2]
At the corner by the station
You pull gently at my sleeve
We could follow all the others
But there is somewhere else to be
[Bridge]
No grand promise, no forever
Just this pavement, just this weather
Every shortcut disappears
When your laughter reaches here
[Chorus]
Take the long way home with me
Past the places we were meant to be
Let the morning wait outside
There is nothing left to hide
[Outro]
Past the station, past the square
I am home when you are there
cases.song_caption: Original melodic deep-house pop song, 120 BPM. Warm expressive adult male tenor sings clear English and a memorable original chorus, with natural breath spaces. Full record production: punchy drums, syncopated rounded bass, muted guitar accents, warm synth chords and atmospheric textures. Brief groove intro, intimate verse, rising pre-chorus, fuller chorus, contrasting bridge and resolved ending. Keep the groove under the voice and leave space for the singer. No piano melody guide, spoken narration, nursery rhyme, repeated chant, borrowed tune or artist imitation.

cases.title: Leave It All Outside
cases.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Keys and coins upon the table
One last message left unread
I have spent the week on standby
Now the room is turning red
Someone opens up the shutters
Someone finds a different beat
All the things I could not answer
Fall behind my moving feet
[Pre-Chorus]
Let the pavement shake below
Take a breath and let it go
[Chorus]
Leave it all outside
Come and find the louder side
Every step is ours to choose
Tonight we have a world to move
[Verse 2]
There are strangers at the doorway
There are friends I never knew
When the rhythm reaches higher
Every face comes into view
[Bridge]
We are more than all the waiting
More than numbers on a screen
Put your shoulder next to mine
Give this moment everything
[Chorus]
Leave it all outside
Come and find the louder side
Every step is ours to choose
Tonight we have a world to move
[Outro]
Let the last light find us here
Moving closer, standing clear
cases.song_caption: Original uplifting Eurodance song, 132 BPM. Driving four-on-the-floor drums, springy syncopated synth bass, bright chord stabs and a distinctive original synth hook. Expressive adult female alto sings clear English with confident rhythmic phrasing and a melodic sing-along chorus. Full energetic record production, open space for the singer, controlled sub bass. Brief intro, developing verses, rising pre-chorus, wide chorus, contrasting bridge and resolved ending. No existing-song quotation, artist imitation, piano melody guide or speech synthesis.
